subject: Copywriting
title: Slack: Where Work Happens
description: A quick, practical guide to Slack: Where Work Happens.

hook.text: 'Where Work Happens' positioned Slack as THE place for work—not one tool among many.

buildup.text: Slack launched in 2013 as a chat tool. The slogan elevated it to a platform—a destination, not just an app.

discovery.text: It's a declarative statement that feels like a fact. 'Where work happens' doesn't argue—it asserts.

twist.text: Slack later dropped it for 'Made for People.' The original was more powerful.

climax.text: The lesson: great slogans feel inevitable. 'Where Work Happens' sounded like it had always been true.

punchline.text: Declare a fact. Own a category. Confidence sells position.

quiz.question: What made 'Where Work Happens' effective?
options: It positioned Slack as THE place for work, not one tool among many

details.summary: Slack's 'Where Work Happens' slogan, launched around 2016, positioned the platform as more than a chat tool — it claimed to be the center of modern work itself. The declarative simplicity and bold territorial claim helped Slack define an entirely new software category.
details.whyItMatters: Where Work Happens shows how a category-defining slogan can be more valuable than product features. By claiming territory rather than listing capabilities, Slack made competitors seem peripheral.
takeaways: The slogan claimed category ownership rather than describing features
Declarative slogans that define territory are hard for rivals to counter
Simplicity made the slogan instantly quotable in business contexts

faq.question: Why is a territorial claim more powerful than a feature list?
faq.answer: Saying 'Where Work Happens' makes Slack synonymous with modern work itself. Competitors are forced to argue 'work also happens here,' which is inherently weaker. Category ownership through language is a classic positioning strategy.

faq.question: Did the slogan accurately describe Slack's product?
faq.answer: For many teams, yes — Slack became the primary coordination layer where decisions were made and information shared. The slogan articulated an aspiration that also matched reality, which is the ideal combination for credibility.
